name: export_editor
description: Export a project for a video editor: writes a package folder <out>/<name> (<Editor>)/ holding <name>.xml (FCP7 XML), a copy of every footage and audio file the timeline uses (media/), one ProRes 4444 alpha movie per overlay (graphics/<clip id>.mov), captions.mov and captions.srt. Cuts, crossfades, speed, placement and sound become real editor clips; overlays and captions are rendered once to transparent movies so they look exactly as in the Montaj render. What an editor cannot hold (moving zoom, loop, background removal, ducking) stays in Montaj and is marked on its clip; the result lists these in leftOut. Nothing already in the out folder is touched: when the package's name is taken the new one is named ... 2, ... 3. Run async (montaj_step async:true) when the project has many overlays, and poll montaj_step_status. Takes a project, not a file input.

input.description: No file input: operates on a project (see the project param).

output.description: {dir (the package folder), open (the file to hand the editor: the .xml), xml, files: [paths relative to dir], leftOut: [{clip, label}], warnings: [...], seconds}

params.name: project
params.description: The project id, its folder, or the absolute path of its project.json

params.name: editor
params.description: Which editor the package is for: premiere (Premiere Pro) and resolve (DaVinci Resolve) read one XML; fcp (Final Cut Pro) gets an FCPXML; ae (After Effects) gets a script that builds the composition and saves an .aep (result carries aep). The package folder carries the editor's name. Only the editors this version of Montaj can write are listed.

params.name: name
params.description: Name of the package and its XML. Defaults to the project's name.

params.name: out
params.description: The folder to put the package in. Defaults to <project_dir>/export/. The package is a new folder inside it; nothing already there is changed or replaced.
